title: Puzzle 3D Language And Terminology Completeness Fixes
description: Dev reported that puzzle-3d still shows English strings ("Window Options", "Fill", etc.) even after switching Settings -> Language to German and Settings -> Terminology to reuse. Live-reproduced via the puzzle-3d-react-dev preview: confirmed "Window Options" (framework chrome, all plugins), "Puzzle 3D" window title, toolbar tool labels (transform/Brush/Fill/Relocate), the Fill tool-options panel (FILL/Fill N of M/Mode/Fill/Edit Volumes), and the "N objects / N attractions" status line all stay in English regardless of the locale/terminology switch. Root cause: Puzzle3dLabels (puzzle/plugin/rs/lib.rs) only had 4 fields (objects/object/vortices/vortex) used solely for the document/kind/inspector trees; the tool-options measure functions (puzzle3d_fill_count_measure, puzzle3d_voxel_mode_measure, puzzle3d_voxel_dim_measures, puzzle3d_fill_tool_options, puzzle3d_voxel_tool_options, puzzle3d_brush_tool_options), the hide/lock tree actions, the world-status engagement text, and the window-kind title (missing app_labels() impl, unlike puzzle-2d/5d) all hardcoded English literals instead of threading the already-in-scope labels/view_state through. Additionally "Window Options" is completely unlocalized framework-chrome text in both the React renderer and the WGPU renderer. Fix: extend Puzzle3dLabels with fill/mode/edit_volumes/voxel/width/depth/height/placement/show/hide/lock/unlock/attractions/window_main fields (native/reuse x en/de), thread labels through every function above, add Puzzle3dPlayApp::app_labels() for window-kind title parity with 2d/5d, and add ui.common.windowOptions/focus/unfocus schema keys + useLabel wiring in ui/js/react/index.tsx's WindowMeasuresChrome (React renderer only). Explicitly out of scope for this ticket: the WGPU renderer's separate "Window Options"/"Focus"/"Unfocus" copies (no existing i18n mechanism there at all - would need net-new infrastructure), and the much larger "manifest verb" toolbar-label gap (Select/Move/Rotate/Scale/Brush/Relocate/Fill utility button text is baked into create_puzzle3d_app's zero-argument static manifest builder, with the identical pattern repeated across all ~23 plugin crates) which would require extending AppLabelsOverlay with a new utility-labels field, a WIT change, and a full 23-crate WASM rebuild - same scale as the prior LOCALE-AWARE-PLUGIN-MANIFEST-LABELS ticket.
summary:
Fixed the concrete violations the dev pointed out ("Window Options", "Fill") plus everything else in the same architectural gap for puzzle-3d.

framework/renderer/react (live-verified, already confirmed rendering correctly in the browser as "Fensteroptionen"/"Fokussieren"/"Fokus aufheben"): added `ui.common.windowOptions`/`focus`/`unfocus` schema keys (EN/DE) to ui/js/react/index.tsx's UiTranslationSchema + both locale bundles, and wired `WindowMeasuresChrome`'s previously-hardcoded "Window Options"/"Focus"/"Unfocus" strings through `useLabel`. This is framework-wide chrome, so it fixes the bug for every plugin app, not just puzzle-3d.

puzzle/plugin/rs/lib.rs (compiles clean via `cargo check`, 58/59 existing tests still pass — the 1 failure is a pre-existing, unrelated test-assertion bug I found and flagged separately, not caused by this change): extended `Puzzle3dLabels` from 4 fields (objects/object/vortices/vortex) to 17, adding fill/mode/edit_volumes/voxel/width/depth/height/placement/show/hide/lock/unlock/attractions/window_main (native + reuse x en/de, reuse only remaps the pre-existing entity nouns, matching precedent). Threaded `labels` through every function that was silently dropping it despite the caller already having it in scope: puzzle3d_fill_count_measure, puzzle3d_voxel_mode_measure, puzzle3d_voxel_dim_measures, puzzle3d_fill_tool_options, puzzle3d_voxel_tool_options, puzzle3d_brush_tool_options, puzzle3d_hide_lock_actions (Show/Hide/Lock/Unlock tree actions), and puzzle3d_engagement (the "N objects / N attractions" world-status line - also fixed a semantic bug here: I initially conflated "attractions" (the connection between two vortices) with "vortices" (the vortex itself) since Puzzle3dLabels had no field for the former; added a dedicated `attractions` field instead of misusing `vortices`). Added `Puzzle3dPlayApp::app_labels()` (previously missing entirely, unlike puzzle-2d/5d) so the "Puzzle 3D" window-kind title now localizes via the existing AppLabelsOverlay/retitle mechanism built in a prior ticket, with zero shell-side changes needed.

Verification: `cargo check --lib` clean, `cargo test --lib` 58/59 pass (pre-existing unrelated failure flagged as its own task). Live-verified the React-side fix in the puzzle-3d-react-dev preview (localhost:6013): switching Language to Deutsch immediately re-labels the shell chrome including the new "Fensteroptionen" button. The Rust-side puzzle-3d fixes (title, Fill/tool-options labels, status line) are code-complete and compile/test-clean but could NOT be live-verified in the browser within this session because the running dev server's WASM rebuild did not complete in time (this environment's cargo builds run ~20-70 minutes) - the dev needs to refresh the puzzle-3d preview once their watcher finishes rebuilding, or run the plugin build manually, to see it live.

Explicitly out of scope (flagged in the ticket description, not attempted): the WGPU renderer's separate, still-hardcoded "Window Options"/"Focus"/"Unfocus" copies in framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs (no i18n mechanism exists there at all yet - would need net-new infrastructure); and the much larger "manifest verb" gap - toolbar tool labels (Select/Move/Rotate/Scale/Brush/Relocate/Fill button text) are baked into create_puzzle3d_app's zero-argument static manifest builder, an identical pattern repeated across all ~23 plugin crates, which would need a new AppLabelsOverlay field + WIT change + full 23-crate WASM rebuild - the same scale as the prior LOCALE-AWARE-PLUGIN-MANIFEST-LABELS ticket. Recommend a dedicated follow-up ticket for that if the dev wants toolbar tool names to translate too.

Also flagged as separate background tasks (not fixed here, confirmed pre-existing/unrelated): a duplicate-declaration bug in compose/client/lib/sketchpad/js/index.ts, and the fill_count_measure test's stale "building" vs "planning" assertion mismatch in puzzle/plugin/rs/lib.rs.
